label: Funnel Chart
description: A conversion funnel of one audience narrowing: centred bands on a log scale (small stages stay readable) joined by tapering necks, one brand hue deepening to the money row, values counting up inside the bands, each step's conversion beside it and the end-to-end rate closing. Sits on the scene ground; type sized from the box.

stages.label: Funnel stages top-to-bottom. Bars draw in sequence with count-ups; each stage after the first shows its conversion from the previous stage; the LAST stage is styled as the money number.

label.description: Stage name (e.g. Sent, Delivered, Opened, Clicked)

value.description: Stage count -- bars scale to the largest stage

show_total.label: Close with the end-to-end conversion (default true for 3+ stages)

theme.label: Ink theme; omit to follow the measured scene ground

at.label: Seconds into the scene the build starts (default 0.2)

exit.label: Fade out before the scene ends (default: hold; the cut is the exit)
